title: Admiral report
description: The end-of-run JSON Commodore writes to $ADMIRAL_REPORT, from jbuffin/admiral#112 'Interfaces between Admiral and the skills', at version 2: `prs` lists objects and `cast` lists the crew. Required fields are Commodore's reading of that contract. Extra top-level properties are allowed, so a later version-2 field breaks nothing. Validate with scripts/schema-check.py.

closes.description: Issues the PR closes, as <owner>/<repo>#<n>. Empty for a PR that closes nothing.

prs.description: Every PR the run opened, plus the PR a pr-feedback run pushed to.

cast.description: The crew members the run used.

inbox.description: Ids of the inbox items written.

resume.description: Text to launch with once every inbox item is answered.
